description.value: At 11th level, a warrior clings to his weaponry even when on the brink of death. A warrior can choose to retain his hold on his wielded weapons when he is knocked unconscious or succumbs to a sleep effect. While the warrior is asleep or unconscious, attackers must succeed at combat maneuver checks to disarm him, but he gains relevant bonuses for attacking a helpless target, including treating the warrior's Dexterity as 0 when determining his CMD.
